title: Warp speed and waypoint movement

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 790469 (0x000c0fc5), HLP file offset 204218 (0x00031dba), topic 90 'Warp Speed'
provenance.note: Warp speed: distance is square of warp; absolute max 10.

setup.baseline: A fleet with a known engine and fuel supply at a fixed waypoint.

procedure: Set a waypoint at a known distance and record arrival year.
Vary warp speed and record distance per year.
Push to warp 9/10 and record ship loss.
Test stargate routing and waypoint snapping.

documented: Actual distance traveled per year is the square of warp speed; absolute maximum is warp 10 (documented-only).
Most ships are safe to warp 9; warp 10 risks a 10% chance of losing each ship unless the engine is warp-10 capable (documented-only).

unresolved: The exact per-year jump/rounding is unknown.
Engine and fleet mass affect speed but the full formula is not recovered here.
